articles.title: Pesha e tepërt mund të përshpejtojë rënien e kujtesës dhe përqendrimit
articles.description: Një studim i Universitetit të Xhorxhias sugjeron se personat me indeks më të lartë të masës trupore mund të përjetojnë rënie më të shpejtë të kujtesës dhe aftësive njohëse me kalimin e viteve.Hulumtimi ndoqi më shumë se 8,200 të rritur mbi moshën 50-vjeçare për një periudhë 24-vjeçare, nga viti 1996 deri në vitin 2020. Studiuesit analizuan ndryshimet në indeksin e masës trupore dhe ndikimin e tyre në funksionet njohëse. Sipas rezultateve, një indeks më i lartë i masës trupore lidhej me rënie më të shpejtë të kujtesës dhe të funksioneve ekzekutive. Këto të fundit përfshijnë përqendrimin, organizimin, planifikimin, kontrollin e emocioneve dhe marrjen e vendimeve.Lidhja mes peshës trupore dhe rënies njohëse ishte më e dukshme te personat mbi 65 vjeç. Studiuesit vërejtën gjithashtu se ndryshimet në këtë drejtim ishin veçanërisht të theksuara rreth vitit të tetë të ndjekjes.Megjithatë, autorët theksojnë se studimi nuk provon se pesha e tepërt shkakton drejtpërdrejt dëmtime të trurit. Ata dyshojnë se procese si inflamacioni, qarkullimi jo i mirë i gjakut dhe rezistenca ndaj insulinës mund të luajnë rol në këtë lidhje.Sipas autorit kryesor, Suhang Song, menaxhimi i peshës mund të ndihmojë në ngadalësimin e rënies së aftësive njohëse. Studiuesit nënvizojnë se identifikimi i faktorëve të rrezikut që mund të kontrollohen është i rëndësishëm në parandalimin e demencës. /Telegrafi/

articles.title: Çfarë i duhet Kosovës në përballje me Irlandën për ta ruajtur pozitën e dytë?
articles.description: Kosova është shumë pranë sigurimit të pozitës së dytë në Grupin 3 të Ligës B të Ligës së Kombeve. Pas ndeshjeve të fundit, “Dardanët” kanë gjashtë pikë dhe renditen në vendin e dytë, një pikë më shumë se Republika e Irlandës, që ndodhet në pozitën e tretë. Izraeli është i fundit me tri pikë.Ndërkohë, Austria e ka siguruar vendin e parë në grup dhe promovimin direkt në Ligën A për edicionin e ardhshëm të Ligës së Kombeve.Tashmë vëmendja e Kosovës është përqendruar te përballja e fundit me Irlandën, që zhvillohet të martën nga ora 20:45 në Dublin. Kjo ndeshje do të përcaktojë se cila prej dy ekipet do ta mbyllë garën në pozitën e dytë. Pamje nga ndeshja Kosovë - Izrael Foto: Ridvan SlivovaPër Kosovën, llogaritë janë të qarta: një barazim do të mjaftonte për ta ruajtur vendin e dytë, pasi do të shkonte në 7 pikë, ndërsa Irlanda do të mbetej me 6 pikë. Në këtë mënyrë, “Dardanët” do ta siguronin pjesëmarrjen në ndeshjet e “play-offit” për promovim në Ligën A, pasi me barazimin ndaj Izraelit, qëndrimi në Ligën B është siguruar. Pas fitores së Austrisë ndaj Irlandës, ja si qëndron situata në grupin e Kosovës për Ligën e Kombeve Pozita e dytë nuk sjell promovim të drejtpërdrejtë, por i jep Kosovës mundësinë të luftojë për ngjitje në elitën e futbollit evropian përmes “play-offit”, ku do të përballej me një përfaqësuese të Ligës A, që përfundojnë në vendet e treta.Përveç rëndësisë në Ligën e Kombeve, përfundimi në vendin e dytë do të ishte gjithashtu i rëndësishëm për Kosovën në funksion të kualifikimeve për Kampionatin Evropian të vitit 2028, pasi renditja përfundimtare e Ligës së Kombeve ndikon në përcaktimin e vazove për shortin kualifikues. Kështu, sfida në Dublin ka peshë të madhe për Kosovën. Një rezultat pozitiv do t’i siguronte vendin e dytë dhe mundësinë për të luftuar për promovim në Ligën A, në një edicion ku Austria tashmë e ka siguruar ngjitjen direkte. /Telegrafi/ Standings provided by Sofascore

articles.title: Katari dhe Turqia nënshkruajnë marrëveshje të mbrojtjes së ndërsjellë kundër sulmeve të jashtme
articles.description: Katari dhe Turqia kanë nënshkruar një marrëveshje të rëndësishme të mbrojtjes së ndërsjellë, me synimin për të forcuar bashkëpunimin strategjik dhe ushtarak, si dhe për të krijuar një qëndrim të përbashkët përballë çdo sulmi të armatosur nga jashtë.Marrëveshja u nënshkrua të premten në Stamboll, gjatë takimit mes presidentit turk, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, dhe emirit të Katarit, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, të cilët bashkëdrejtuan mbledhjen e Komitetit të Lartë Strategjik mes dy vendeve, transmeton Telegrafi.Sipas një deklarate të përbashkët, marrëveshja synon “forcimin e mbrojtjes kolektive dhe arritjen e sigurisë dhe stabilitetit rajonal”, si dhe “miratimin e një qëndrimi të unifikuar përballë çdo sulmi të armatosur nga jashtë, që synon njërën ose të dyja palët”.تواصل الشراكة الاستراتيجية بين قطر وتركيا تطورها في مختلف المجالات وهو ما عكسه اجتماع الدورة الـ12 للجنة الاستراتيجية العليا بين بلدينا، الذي ترأسته اليوم في إسطنبول مع أخي الرئيس رجب طيب أردوغان، حيث بحثنا سبل البناء على ما تحقق وتحديد أولويات العمل المشترك خلال المرحلة المقبلة. https://t.co/cPvH0sZS23— تميم بن حمد (@TamimBinHamad) November 13, 2026“Palët ranë dakord të zhvillojnë konsultime lidhur me kërcënimet ndaj sigurisë së tyre dhe të forcojnë bashkëpunimin përmes stërvitjeve të përbashkëta ushtarake, bashkëpunimit në industrinë e mbrojtjes dhe shkëmbimit të personelit për trajnim”, thuhet në deklaratë.Të dyja vendet theksuan se marrëveshja pasqyron vizionin e tyre të përbashkët për një rend rajonal më të sigurt dhe më të qëndrueshëm. Zyra e Erdoganit deklaroi se ajo do t'u japë “një dimension të ri lidhjeve vëllazërore” mes dy shteteve.تواصل الشراكة الاستراتيجية بين قطر وتركيا تطورها في مختلف المجالات وهو ما عكسه اجتماع الدورة Ali bin Ahmed Al-Kuwari, Minister of Finance of the State of Qatar, convened the meeting of the Joint Economic and Financial Committee in Istanbul on 19-20 February 2025. In this regard, they agreed to take concrete steps aimed at advancing cooperation across areas of mutual interest.To encourage ongoing activities within the Turkish and Qatari private sector, the two sides agreed to increase participation in trade events and exhibitions and facilitate trade promotion activities between them.Both sides welcomed the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in Consumer Protection andMarket Surveillance and underscored its importance in further enhancing bilateral economic cooperation, and strengthening institutional collaboration between the two countries in the margins of the Twelfth Session of the Supreme Strategic Committee.In this regard, both sides reaffirmed their shared commitmentfor advancing the initiative of the “Memorandum of Understanding on the Facilitation of Regional Trade, whichaims establishing a coordinated framework for trade and logistics cooperation, enhancing regional connectivity, and facilitating more efficient, diversified, and resilient trade flows for mutual benefit through historical and traditional trade routes, in coordination with relevant partner countries.The parties expressed their confidence that the banking and financial relations between Türkiye and Qatar, built upon the strong bonds of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, will continue to grow in the period ahead on the basis of mutual trust and shared interests, and will be further strengthened through new opportunities for cooperation.The Parties expressed their respective commitment to bilateral and regional energy security and to further enhancing their cooperation in the energy sector, including the diversification of energy sources and the strengthening of regional energy supply security.The Parties expressed their readiness to realize concrete energy collaborations, particularly in LNG trade, building on their strong, long-standing relationships.Cooperation in the Field of Culture and EducationThe Parties emphasized the importance they attach to further developing the existing cooperation in the field of education between the Republic of Türkiye and the State of Qatar. In this regard, they agreed to strengthen cooperation in the establishment and operation of educational institutions, professional development of teachers, promotion of Turkish and Arabic language teaching, exchange of knowledge and experience in education, and encouragement of student and teacher mobility.The two sides welcomed the signing of the Agreement in the Field of Education and expressed their confidence that it would further enhance bilateral cooperation and promote deeper collaboration between the relevant institutions of both countries in the field of education.The parties expressed their satisfaction with the steps to be taken towards the development of cultural relations between Qatar and Türkiye.Qatar and Türkiye agreed to activate cultural, artistic and folkloric activities and events that reflect the rich culture and history of the two countries, and expand the horizon of cultural harmony between the peoples of the two sisterly countries.In this regard, the two sides also commended the efforts made in organizing exhibitions and mutual activities to celebrate the historical and cultural commonalities that constitute an important pillar in the consolidation of cultural diplomacy between the two countries, through activities organized under the auspices of cultural centers and exhibitions in relevant fields.The Parties agreed to cooperate in the fields of protection, preservation and restoration of cultural heritage. They also agreed to support the exchange of technical knowledge, experience and experts, and the organization of meetings and training programs.The two sides expressed their desire to enhance avenues of cooperation through the exchange of expertise between the Turkish National Commission in the fields of education, culture, and science, and the National Commission for Education, Culture, and Science of the State of Qatar as well as through the development of digital educational platforms in both countries.Both sides discussed the possibility of a joint scholarship program, including potential contributions from the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Qatar Fund for Development (QFFD). They noted that such a program could provide students from conflict-affected and disadvantaged countries in the Islamic world with opportunities to study at universities in Qatar and Türkiye. Any participation or contribution would be subject to the respective institutions’ internal approvals and a separate written agreement.Cooperation in the Field of Media and CommunicationTechnologiesThe two sides welcomed the progress achieved under the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Fields of Information and Communication Technology signed on 4 December 2023 and agreed to conduct concrete joint work programs in the fields of digital transformation, artificial intelligence, quantum technologies and cybersecurity. The two sides underlined their readiness to further develop cooperation between their national cybersecurity authorities in the areas of exchange of experience and capacity building.Türkiye congratulated the State of Qatar on its successful hosting of the Plenipotentiary Conference of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). in the Field of Public HealthThe two sides affirmed their readiness to strengthen cooperation in the health sector by activating the executive program and memorandums of understanding signed between the two countries through the establishment of a joint working group or committee.Both sides welcomed the readiness of the Ministry of Public Health of the State of Qatar and the Halal Accreditation Agency (HAK) to exchange expertise, share information, and provide training programs for the relevant institutions in both countries in the areas of halal accreditation and quality infrastructure for halal products.The two sides also underscored the importance of strengthening international cooperation within the framework of the OIC Global Halal Quality Infrastructure and welcomed the willingness of HAK to engage in cooperation activities through the Islamic Forum for Halal Accreditation Bodies (IFHAB).Cooperation in the field of Youth and SportsThe two sides expressed their readiness to cooperate in the fields of youth and sports.The Implementation Program between the Government of the Republic of Türkiye and the Government of the State of Qatar in the fields of youth and sports for the years (2025-2026), constitutes a concrete legal framework for strengthening cooperation in this field.Cooperation in the field of Labour and EmploymentBoth sides expressed their satisfaction with the cooperation resulting from the legal framework established in the areas of labour and employment.The two sides have reached an agreement to hold the fourth meeting of the Joint Working Committee established under the Labor Force Employment Agreement dated April 1, 1986, and the first meeting of the Joint Committee established under the provisions of the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Field of Labor dated November 4, 2023, jointly.Cooperation in the Field of DefenseBoth parties expressed their determination to address mutual security concerns as a strategic priority and to further enhance cooperation on defense-related issues.The parties commended the signing of the Mutual Defense Agreement between Qatar and Türkiye with the aim of strengthening collective defense and promoting regional security and stability, and a unified stance in confronting any external armed attack targeting either party or both of them.The two sides reaffirmed that the Agreement reflects not only the commitment of its signatories to safeguarding their sovereignty and territorial integrity, but also their shared vision of contributing to a more secure and stable regional order.In this context, both parties agreed to consult on, threats to their security as well as regional and global security issues and defense policies, and to enhance cooperation through joint military exercises, defense industry cooperation and personnel training exchanges.The two sides commended the signing of the BadrMemorandum by Qatar, Türkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia as an important step towards enhancing their collective capacity to meet defense requirements through the development of indigenous capabilities. They noted that the Memorandum will pave the way for closer cooperation in the fields of joint production, technology development, exchange of information and expertise, as well as the strengthening of defense industrial infrastructure and supply chains.Cooperation in the Field of Science, Technology,Innovation and IndustryThe two sides expressed their satisfaction with the level of cooperation in the fields of science, technology and innovation and reaffirmed their aspiration, recorded at the Eleventh Meeting, to continue developing key technologies together.The two sides expressed their desire to further strengthen their strategic partnership through joint investments and projects in industry, technology and innovation. Both sides emphasized the importance of advancing cooperation under the Industrial Partnership for Sustainable Economic Development, enhancing supply chain integration, and supporting SMEs through joint initiatives and technology development.Both sides highlighted the importance of fostering closer linkages among technology start-ups, technoparks, research institutions and investors in both countries. In this regard, they expressed their readiness to explore opportunities for joint acceleration programmes, entrepreneur and investor networking initiatives, and activities aimed at facilitating mutual market access.The Parties welcomed the strategic partnership agreement signed between Türksat and Es’hailSat on 19 May 2026, and the Es’hail-3/Türksat-Biruni satellite project as a concrete example of the strategic partnership between the two countries in the field of space and satellite technologies. In this regard, they agreed to take concrete steps aimed at advancing cooperation across areas of mutual interest.To encourage ongoing activities within the Turkish and Qatari private sector, the two sides agreed to increase participation in trade events and exhibitions and facilitate trade promotion activities between them.Both sides welcomed the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in Consumer Protection andMarket Surveillance and underscored its importance in further enhancing bilateral economic cooperation, and strengthening institutional collaboration between the two countries in the margins of the Twelfth Session of the Supreme Strategic Committee.In this regard, both sides reaffirmed their shared commitmentfor advancing the initiative of the “Memorandum of Understanding on the Facilitation of Regional Trade, whichaims establishing a coordinated framework for trade and logistics cooperation, enhancing regional connectivity, and facilitating more efficient, diversified, and resilient trade flows for mutual benefit through historical and traditional trade routes, in coordination with relevant partner countries.The parties expressed their confidence that the banking and financial relations between Türkiye and Qatar, built upon the strong bonds of friendship and cooperation between the two countries, will continue to grow in the period ahead on the basis of mutual trust and shared interests, and will be further strengthened through new opportunities for cooperation.The Parties expressed their respective commitment to bilateral and regional energy security and to further enhancing their cooperation in the energy sector, including the diversification of energy sources and the strengthening of regional energy supply security.The Parties expressed their readiness to realize concrete energy collaborations, particularly in LNG trade, building on their strong, long-standing relationships.Cooperation in the Field of Culture and EducationThe Parties emphasized the importance they attach to further developing the existing cooperation in the field of education between the Republic of Türkiye and the State of Qatar. In this regard, they agreed to strengthen cooperation in the establishment and operation of educational institutions, professional development of teachers, promotion of Turkish and Arabic language teaching, exchange of knowledge and experience in education, and encouragement of student and teacher mobility.The two sides welcomed the signing of the Agreement in the Field of Education and expressed their confidence that it would further enhance bilateral cooperation and promote deeper collaboration between the relevant institutions of both countries in the field of education.The parties expressed their satisfaction with the steps to be taken towards the development of cultural relations between Qatar and Türkiye.Qatar and Türkiye agreed to activate cultural, artistic and folkloric activities and events that reflect the rich culture and history of the two countries, and expand the horizon of cultural harmony between the peoples of the two sisterly countries.In this regard, the two sides also commended the efforts made in organizing exhibitions and mutual activities to celebrate the historical and cultural commonalities that constitute an important pillar in the consolidation of cultural diplomacy between the two countries, through activities organized under the auspices of cultural centers and exhibitions in relevant fields.The Parties agreed to cooperate in the fields of protection, preservation and restoration of cultural heritage. They also agreed to support the exchange of technical knowledge, experience and experts, and the organization of meetings and training programs.The two sides expressed their desire to enhance avenues of cooperation through the exchange of expertise between the Turkish National Commission in the fields of education, culture, and science, and the National Commission for Education, Culture, and Science of the State of Qatar as well as through the development of digital educational platforms in both countries.Both sides discussed the possibility of a joint scholarship program, including potential contributions from the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Qatar Fund for Development (QFFD). They noted that such a program could provide students from conflict-affected and disadvantaged countries in the Islamic world with opportunities to study at universities in Qatar and Türkiye. Any participation or contribution would be subject to the respective institutions’ internal approvals and a separate written agreement.Cooperation in the Field of Media and CommunicationTechnologiesThe two sides welcomed the progress achieved under the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Fields of Information and Communication Technology signed on 4 December 2023 and agreed to conduct concrete joint work programs in the fields of digital transformation, artificial intelligence, quantum technologies and cybersecurity. The two sides underlined their readiness to further develop cooperation between their national cybersecurity authorities in the areas of exchange of experience and capacity building.Türkiye congratulated the State of Qatar on its successful hosting of the Plenipotentiary Conference of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). The two sides agreed to continue their coordination and mutual support in the field of information and communication technologies within international organizations, in particular the ITU.Cooperation in the Field of Public HealthThe two sides affirmed their readiness to strengthen cooperation in the health sector by activating the executive program and memorandums of understanding signed between the two countries through the establishment of a joint working group or committee.Both sides welcomed the readiness of the Ministry of Public Health of the State of Qatar and the Halal Accreditation Agency (HAK) to exchange expertise, share information, and provide training programs for the relevant institutions in both countries in the areas of halal accreditation and quality infrastructure for halal products.The two sides also underscored the importance of strengthening international cooperation within the framework of the OIC Global Halal Quality Infrastructure and welcomed the willingness of HAK to engage in cooperation activities through the Islamic Forum for Halal Accreditation Bodies (IFHAB).Cooperation in the field of Youth and SportsThe two sides expressed their readiness to cooperate in the fields of youth and sports.The Implementation Program between the Government of the Republic of Türkiye and the Government of the State of Qatar in the fields of youth and sports for the years (2025-2026), constitutes a concrete legal framework for strengthening cooperation in this field.Cooperation in the field of Labour and EmploymentBoth sides expressed their satisfaction with the cooperation resulting from the legal framework established in the areas of labour and employment.The two sides have reached an agreement to hold the fourth meeting of the Joint Working Committee established under the Labor Force Employment Agreement dated April 1, 1986, and the first meeting of the Joint Committee established under the provisions of the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Field of Labor dated November 4, 2023, jointly.Cooperation in the Field of DefenseBoth parties expressed their determination to address mutual security concerns as a strategic priority and to further enhance cooperation on defense-related issues.The parties commended the signing of the Mutual Defense Agreement between Qatar and Türkiye with the aim of strengthening collective defense and promoting regional security and stability, and a unified stance in confronting any external armed attack targeting either party or both of them.The two sides reaffirmed that the Agreement reflects not only the commitment of its signatories to safeguarding their sovereignty and territorial integrity, but also their shared vision of contributing to a more secure and stable regional order.In this context, both parties agreed to consult on, threats to their security as well as regional and global security issues and defense policies, and to enhance cooperation through joint military exercises, defense industry cooperation and personnel training exchanges.The two sides commended the signing of the BadrMemorandum by Qatar, Türkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia as an important step towards enhancing their collective capacity to meet defense requirements through the development of indigenous capabilities. They noted that the Memorandum will pave the way for closer cooperation in the fields of joint production, technology development, exchange of information and expertise, as well as the strengthening of defense industrial infrastructure and supply chains.Cooperation in the Field of Science, Technology,Innovation and IndustryThe two sides expressed their satisfaction with the level of cooperation in the fields of science, technology and innovation and reaffirmed their aspiration, recorded at the Eleventh Meeting, to continue developing key technologies together.The two sides expressed their desire to further strengthen their strategic partnership through joint investments and projects in industry, technology and innovation. Both sides emphasized the importance of advancing cooperation under the Industrial Partnership for Sustainable Economic Development, enhancing supply chain integration, and supporting SMEs through joint initiatives and technology development.Both sides highlighted the importance of fostering closer linkages among technology start-ups, technoparks, research institutions and investors in both countries. In this regard, they expressed their readiness to explore opportunities for joint acceleration programmes, entrepreneur and investor networking initiatives, and activities aimed at facilitating mutual market access.The Parties welcomed the strategic partnership agreement signed between Türksat and Es’hailSat on 19 May 2026, and the Es’hail-3/Türksat-Biruni satellite project as a concrete example of the strategic partnership between the two countries in the field of space and satellite technologies. The two sides expressed their determination to provide the necessary support for the successful implementation of this partnership and encouraged their space agencies and research institutions to explore opportunities for cooperation in small satellites, Earth observation and satellite communications.Both sides underlined the importance they attach to developing national capabilities in artificial intelligence. They encouraged the exchange of experience between the national large language models of the two countries on multilingual and culturally aware artificial intelligence, as well as the establishment of a direct dialogue between the institutions responsible for the implementation of Türkiye’s National Artificial Intelligence Action Plan and the National Center for Artificial Intelligence of the State of Qatar. The two sides also agreed to explore opportunities for joint research and researcher exchange between their research institutions in the fields of quantum computing and quantum communications.Cooperation in the Field of SecurityBoth sides expressed their will to increase their cooperation in the field of law enforcement training, security and required fields in accordance with the agreement of “Security Cooperation Protocol in Education and Training” signed on 02 December, 2015, and “Agreement of Security Cooperation” signed on 25 December, 2001. Furthermore, the two countries will jointly organize meetings for the purpose of exchanging knowledge, supporting training programs and projects.Within this framework, Türkiye and Qatar can implement short and long term programs aimed at delivering security-related assistance, including technical support and training. These initiatives will be coordinated via the international cooperation departments and contact points of their respective Ministries of Interior, as well as bilateral meetings of the Joint Turkish-Qatari Security Committee, ultimately serving to exchange expertise and enhance the institutional and operational capabilities of both law enforcement forces.The parties affirmed that the Memorandum of Understanding to be signed between The Turkish Data Protection Authority (KVKK) and the National Cyber Security Agency (NCSA) of Qatar aims to strengthen cooperation in the field of data protection and enhance potential joint initiatives. This memorandum will establish the general framework for cooperation regarding the sharing of best practices between the two authorities, while also enabling collaborative efforts in the area of personal data protection. They agreed that this cooperation will facilitate the sharing of best practices and the mutual exchange of knowledge and experience in the field of personal data protection between the two institutions.Development, Humanitarian and Relief CooperationThe two sides welcomed the entry into force of the Cooperation Agreement on Humanitarian Aid signed in Ankara on 14 November 2024 and agreed to convene the Joint Committee for Coordination and Cooperation provided for in its Article 4.The two sides expressed deep concern at the growing number of attacks, acts of violence and threats against humanitarian personnel. They reiterated their commitment to the Declaration for the Protection of Humanitarian Personnel and reaffirmed their support for the call in Security Council resolution 2730 (2024) on all States to respect and protect humanitarian personnel and United Nations and associated personnel, in accordance with the international law. Both sides urge the immediate and unconditional release of all detained humanitarian workers and UN personnel.They also commended the bilateral efforts of the two countries’ relevant authorities in the field of Development, Humanitarian and Relief Cooperation in third countries.The two sides reaffirmed their commitment to continuing consultations and coordination on matter of mutual concern in the fields of international development and humanitarian cooperation.The two sides agreed to coordinate their support for the early recovery and reconstruction of Gaza as well as the humanitarian aid efforts for Gaza. They also called for full, safe and unhindered humanitarian access in Gaza, and agreed to cooperate closely to scale up shelter and humanitarian assistance in Gaza. Both sides also underscore the urgent need for action, as the first flash floods of the winter season have struck Palestinians in Gaza, further exacerbating their already dire living conditions and rendering them increasingly unbearable.Cooperation in the Field of Environment and Climate ChangeThe Parties underlined the importance of cooperation on sustainable development and climate change. In this context, Qatar congratulated Türkiye on successfully organizing the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) from 9 to 20 November 2026.Both sides agreed to collaborate closely on promoting environmental sustainability initiatives and practices to advance the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, fostering innovation and resource efficiency, including the Zero Waste Initiative in areas of shared interest.Cooperation in the Field of Family and Social ServicesThe two sides reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening cooperation in the field of family and social services, based on the strong bonds of friendship and brotherhood between the two countries. In this regard, they emphasized the importance of enhancing cooperation and exchanging knowledge and experience in areas such as strengthening the family institution, child protection, the empowerment of women, services for older persons and persons with disabilities, and social assistance programs.Regional and International IssuesThe two sides expressed their satisfaction with the high-level dialogue, cooperation and coordination on regional and international issues.The two sides affirmed that the Political Consultations held on 14 May 2026 provided a useful opportunity to exchange views on bilateral relations as well as regional and international developments of mutual interest. The Parties expressed their satisfaction with the constructive outcome of the consultations and looked forward to holding the next round of Political Consultations on a mutually agreed date in 2027.Türkiye and Qatar have demonstrated their commitment to further strengthening and institutionalizing their existing cooperation in the fields of mediation and conflict resolution by signing the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Field of Peace.Recognizing their respective roles in mediation and facilitation, Türkiye and Qatar have agreed to further strengthen their cooperation and coordination, including through regular consultations and the exchange of expertise, and to continue their joint efforts to prevent and peacefully resolve conflicts and promote lasting peace and stability through mediation, facilitation and preventive diplomacy.As mediating countries, in close cooperation with the brotherly Arab Republic of Egypt, both sides expressed deep concern regarding the ongoing Israeli violations in Gaza that undermine the implementation of the Comprehensive Plan to End the Gaza Conflict, endorsed by UN Security Council Resolution 2803 (2025), including its second phase, following the Palestinian factions’ acceptance of the relevant implementation roadmap. They called on Israel to complyfully with all its obligations under the ceasefire agreement and international law, and stressed the importance of protecting civilians and ensuring unhindered humanitarian access.The Parties strongly condemned Israel’s illegal settlement activities, settler violence and terrorism, land confiscation and forced displacement in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and rejected all measures aimed at altering the legal, geographic and demographic status of the Occupied Palestinian Territory. They also reiterated their categorical rejection of any attempts to alter the historical and legal status quo at Al-Aqsa Mosque and other Islamic and Christian holy sites in occupied Jerusalem, while recognizing the special role of the historical Hashemite custodianship They condemned continued incursions by extremist Israeli settlers and officials into Al-Aqsa Mosque under the protection of Israeli forces, and reaffirmed that the entire area of the Mosque, amounting to 144 dunams, is a place of worship exclusively for Muslims, and that the Jerusalem Endowments and Al Aqsa Mosque Affairs Department is the competent authority for its administration.🔗 For the full Statement, please visit our website: https://t.co/4eeNhlqmcj#MOFAQatar— Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Qatar (@MofaQatar_EN) November 13, 2026President @RTErdogan met with Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani of Qatar at Dolmabahçe Presidential Office in Istanbul. https://t.co/17zjrLC92o— Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye (@trpresidency) November 13, 2026Përveç marrëveshjes së mbrojtjes, Katari dhe Turqia nënshkruan edhe disa marrëveshje të tjera për bashkëpunimin në tregti, energji, diplomaci, arsim dhe kulturë.Marrëveshja vjen në një periudhë të ndryshimeve të shpejta në arkitekturën e sigurisë në Gjirin Persik dhe Lindjen e Mesme, të nxitura nga lufta me Iranin dhe sinjalet e SHBA-së për përshtatjen e pranisë së saj afatgjatë të sigurisë në rajon. /Telegrafi/ - YouTube www.youtube.com

articles.title: Machine Gun Kelly dhe Dakota Johnson shihen sërish bashkë, romanca e tyre po bëhet gjithnjë e më serioze
articles.description: Aktorja, Dakota Johnson, dhe muzikanti Machine Gun Kelly kanë nxitur sërish interesimin për romancën e tyre të përfolur, pasi janë fotografuar së bashku jashtë një studioje muzikore në Los Angeles.Dyshja u pa të enjten duke biseduar në një parking, vetëm një ditë pasi aktorja 37-vjeçare kishte shoqëruar muzikantin në një tjetër seancë regjistrimi.Johnson kishte zgjedhur një kombinim të zi me motive lulesh ngjyrë bezhë, ndërsa MGK, 36 vjeç, kishte veshur pantallona të gjera jeshile, një bluzë të bardhë dhe një këmishë me nuanca të errëta. Sipas Daily Mail, aktorja dhe muzikanti kanë kaluar shumë kohë së bashku gjatë javëve të fundit, ndërsa thashethemet për lidhjen e tyre nisën në shtator, kur të dy u panë duke vizituar apartamentin e Taylor Swift në New York.Ndërkohë, një burim pranë aktores ka ndarë detaje për marrëdhënien e tyre, duke pretenduar se Johnson është shumë e lumtur me kiminë që ka krijuar me muzikantin. “Ajo u ka thënë miqve se kanë kimi të shkëlqyer seksuale dhe se është seksi më i mirë që ka pasur ndonjëherë. Ajo e përshkruan si ‘fishekzjarre’”, ka deklaruar burimi.Sipas të njëjtit burim, aktorja beson se shenjat e tyre të horoskopit, Peshorja dhe Demi, ndikojnë në lidhjen e tyre, pasi të dyja udhëhiqen nga Venusi, planeti që në astrologji lidhet me dashurinë dhe kënaqësinë. “Ajo e adhuron pamjen dhe tatuazhet e tij, mendon se është shumë seksi”, shtoi burimi.Machine Gun Kelly, emri i vërtetë i të cilit është Colson Baker, më parë ishte në një lidhje disavjeçare me aktoren Megan Fox, me të cilën ka një vajzë. Ai është gjithashtu baba i një vajze tjetër nga një marrëdhënie e mëparshme.As Johnson dhe as MGK nuk e kanë konfirmuar publikisht lidhjen e tyre të përfolur. /Telegrafi/

articles.title: Moti sot në Maqedoninë e Veriut
articles.description: Mot i ndryshueshëm me vranësira me periudha me diell, por edhe reshje të herëpashershme shiu në pasdite - ky është moti që mund të presim sot, informon DPHM.Në orët e mëngjesit, do të ketë kushte për mjegull në disa lugina, dhe do të fryjë erë e dobët deri në mesatare nga jugu, e cila do të jetë më e theksuar përgjatë lumit Vardar. Temperatura e mëngjesit do të lëvizë nga disa gradë mbi zero deri në rreth 10 gradë, ndërsa temperaturat e ditës do të mbeten relativisht të larta për këtë periudhë të vitit.Në Shkup do të mbizotërojë mot i ndryshueshëm me vranësira, me mundësi për reshje të herëpashershme shiu në pasdite dhe erë të dobët deri në mesatare juglindore.Moti i ndryshueshëm me reshje lokale do të vazhdojë edhe në ditët në vijim, por nga e hëna pritet një rritje graduale e temperaturave, të cilat përsëri do të jenë mbi mesataren për mesin e nëntorit.Përveç ngrohjes, meteorologët paralajmërojnë edhe një intensifikim të erës së jugut. Nga fillimi i javës së ardhshme, do të jetë mesatare deri e fortë, dhe nga e mërkura herë pas here do të arrijë shpejtësi mbi 60 kilometra në orë, veçanërisht në pjesët perëndimore të vendit.

articles.title: Qindra burra protestojnë në Bernë kundër dhunës ndaj grave
articles.description: Qindra burra kanë protestuar në sheshin Bundesplatz, para Parlamentit Federal në Bernë të Zvicrës, kundër dhunës ndaj grave, duke kërkuar më shumë përgjegjësi dhe angazhim nga burrat në luftën kundër këtij fenomeni.Protesta, e cila zgjati rreth një orë, u organizua nga një aleancë e gjerë ku përfshiheshin Partia Socialdemokrate e Zvicrës (SP) dhe komiteti “Männer gegen Gewalt an Frauen” (Burrat kundër dhunës ndaj grave). Organizatorët u bënë thirrje burrave që të tregojnë solidaritet me viktimat, të mos heshtin përballë dhunës dhe të reagojnë kur përballen me raste të tilla në rrethin e tyre shoqëror.Sipas organizatorëve, dhuna ndaj grave në shumicën e rasteve ushtrohet nga burrat, prandaj ata duhet të marrin përgjegjësi dhe të kundërshtojnë hapur sjelljet e dhunshme, përfshirë edhe ato të personave të afërt, shkruan SRF, transmeton Telegrafi.Gjatë protestës u theksua edhe përmasat e ngacmimeve dhe dhunës seksuale në Zvicër.Sipas shifrave të përmendura nga organizatorët, më shumë se gjysma e grave në vend kanë përjetuar ngacmime seksuale, ndërsa një në pesë gra ka qenë viktimë e veprimeve seksuale të padëshiruara.Me këtë aksion solidariteti, pjesëmarrësit synuan të dërgojnë mesazhin se lufta kundër dhunës ndaj grave nuk është vetëm përgjegjësi e viktimave apo e institucioneve, por kërkon edhe angazhimin aktiv të burrave./Telegrafi/

articles.title: Armend Xhoxhaj pëson humbje në Magdeburg
articles.description: Boksieri shqiptar Armend Xhoxhaj është mposhtur nga gjermani Roman Fress, në përballjen e zhvilluar në sallën e ekspozitës së Magdeburgut. Fress triumfoi me vendim unanim të gjyqtarëve, duke fituar për herë të parë ndaj Xhoxhajt në duelin e tyre të tretë.Kjo përballje ishte cilësuar si “finalja e madhe” dhe u karakterizua nga një luftë intensive mes dy boksierëve. Pas humbjes në vitin 2022 dhe barazimit në maj të vitit 2026, Fress arriti më në fund ta mposhtte rivalin shqiptar.Fress e nisi më mirë meçin, por Xhoxhaj mori iniciativën në raundet nga i katërti deri në të nëntin, ku u paraqit më mirë se kundërshtari. Armend Xhoxhaj gjatë duelit Foto: Eroll PopovaNë raundin e dhjetë, gjermani u godit në syrin e djathtë. Sipas raportimit, gjyqtari nuk e vërejti një goditje me kokë të qëllimshme. Pas këtij raundi, eksperti i MDR-së, Dominic Bösel, vlerësoi se Fress duhej t’i fitonte dy raundet e fundit për të siguruar fitoren.Në fund, gjyqtarët vendosën unanimisht në favor të boksierit vendas. Dy prej tyre e vlerësuan meçin 115-113, ndërsa i treti 116-112 për Fressin.Me këtë triumf, Fress mbrojti titullin ndërkontinental të WBO-së dhe fitoi edhe rripin e Kampionatit Evropian të kësaj organizate. Gjermani tashmë mund të shpresojë për një përballje për titullin botëror të WBO-së. /Telegrafi/
